name: OpenManus
description: 开源通用 AI Agent 框架，支持 Computer Use、Browser Use、MCP 工具调用和多 Agent 协同。由 MetaGPT 团队开发，无需邀请码即可使用

methods.name: uv 安装（推荐）
methods.command: if ! command -v uv &>/dev/null; then curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh; fi && git clone https://github.com/FoundationAgents/OpenManus.git && cd OpenManus && uv venv --python 3.12 && source .venv/bin/activate && uv pip install -r requirements.txt && cp config/config.example.toml config/config.toml

methods.name: conda 安装
methods.command: conda create -n open_manus python=3.12 -y && conda activate open_manus && git clone https://github.com/FoundationAgents/OpenManus.git && cd OpenManus && pip install -r requirements.txt && cp config/config.example.toml config/config.toml

update.command: cd OpenManus && git pull && source .venv/bin/activate && uv pip install -r requirements.txt

post_install.command:
echo -e '
请编辑 OpenManus/config/config.toml 配置 LLM API Key
推荐模型: gpt-4o / claude-sonnet-4-20250514
如使用本地 vLLM，设置 base_url 为 http://localhost:8000/v1'

post_install.description: 可选安装浏览器自动化
post_install.command: cd OpenManus && source .venv/bin/activate && playwright install 2>/dev/null || echo 'Playwright 安装跳过 (可选)'

operations.view: cat OpenManus/config/config.toml 2>/dev/null || echo '配置文件不存在'

commands.version: cd OpenManus && git describe --tags 2>/dev/null || git log --oneline -1

status_check.name: 检查安装
status_check.command: ls -d OpenManus 2>/dev/null && echo '已安装' || echo '未安装'

status_check.name: 检查虚拟环境
status_check.command: ls OpenManus/.venv/bin/activate 2>/dev/null && echo 'venv 就绪' || echo 'venv 不存在'

status_check.name: 检查配置
status_check.command: ls OpenManus/config/config.toml 2>/dev/null && echo '配置已创建' || echo '配置未创建'

notes: 需要配置 LLM API (GPT-4o / Claude 等)。可搭配本地 vLLM 服务使用。三种运行模式: 单 Agent (main.py)、MCP 模式 (run_mcp.py)、多 Agent 协同 (run_flow.py)
